entities.name: Query lipase protein
observations: 372 aa sequence; estimated molecular mass 41.996 kDa and theoretical pI 9.08.
Contains a Pfam lipase domain PF00151 spanning residues 2-257 and a PLAT domain PF01477 spanning residues 262-371.
Shows 69.4% identity over 100% of the query to reviewed human hepatic triacylglycerol lipase P11150; E-value 1.33e-191.
Likely serine hydrolase/lipase that hydrolyzes triacylglycerols and glycerophospholipids; exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs, not directly demonstrated.
Likely participates in extracellular lipid or lipoprotein remodeling and lipid catabolism.
No N-terminal signal peptide is evident in the query sequence itself; extracellular/secreted localization is inferred from homolog annotation and should be treated cautiously.
Basic sequence character: predicted charge at pH 7 is approximately +9.5; no transmembrane segment was reported.
No metal or small-molecule cofactor requirement was reported by the available annotation.

entities.name: Human hepatic triacylglycerol lipase
observations: UniProt P11150 is a reviewed secreted homodimeric lipase.
Hydrolyzes triacylglycerols and phospholipids in circulating lipoproteins, releasing free fatty acids and smaller lipoprotein particles.
Also has lysophospholipase activity; annotated EC activities include triacylglycerol lipase, glycerophospholipid phospholipase A1, and phosphatidylcholine lysophospholipase A1.
Associated processes include cholesterol homeostasis, chylomicron-remnant clearance, and remodeling of HDL, IDL, and LDL particles.

entities.name: Lipase domain PF00151
observations: Detected in the query at residues 2-257 with i-Evalue 1e-106.
Supports alpha/beta hydrolase-family lipase activity by sequence homology.

entities.name: PLAT domain PF01477
observations: Detected in the query at residues 262-371 with i-Evalue 9.7e-11.
A C-terminal PLAT domain is consistent with a lipid-binding or membrane-interface interaction module found in hepatic lipase-family proteins.
